Workday HCM Technical – Roles and Responsibilities

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

1. Workday Technical Configuration

* Configure and maintain Workday HCM technical components.
* Develop and support custom business processes and technical solutions.
* Configure calculated fields, condition rules, and validation rules.

2. Workday Integrations

4. Workday Data Migration

* Support employee data migration from legacy HR systems to Workday.

5. Workday Security

* Configure and maintain domain and business process security.
* Support role-based security and user access management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security policies.

6. Workday Studio Development

* Develop complex integrations using Workday Studio.
* Build reusable integration components.
* Implement error handling, logging, and monitoring mechanisms.

7. Testing and Deployment

* Perform unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing support.
* Troubleshoot technical defects and integration issues.
* Support Workday releases, enhancements, and deployments.

8. Production Support

* Monitor scheduled integrations and resolve failures.
* Provide technical support for Workday HCM applications.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Work closely with engineering and product management to plan, create, and maintain user-focused technical documentation for multiple product features or applications, in alignment with an established content strategy
* Provide input to help shape future content strategy for the product or business unit you help to support
* Contribute to the continued evolution of ServiceNow’s content development processes, DITA-based information model, and writing style and standards
* Develop a strong understanding of the ServiceNow product ecosystem and expert knowledge of the specific product area and user base you support

  
**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Demonstrate English language proficiency through an assessment via HackerRank, evaluating grammar, sentence structure, and skills in clear, user-centric, and procedural writing.
* Understanding of content development life cycles and processes
* 4+ years work experience in technical communication
* Samples of your prior technical writing work or other writing that demonstrates your ability to communicate complex ideas and technical information clearly
* Experience authoring in the Darwin Information Typing Architecture (DITA) or another XML-based structured authoring architecture
* Experience independently planning, creating, and delivering documentation in a fast-paced, globally distributed software development environment
* Ability and eagerness to demonstrate leadership by mentoring other writers, adapting quickly to changing priorities, and helping diverse cross-functional teams collaborate effectively to deliver exceptional results

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. **Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. title: Technical Writer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role**

We have a well established technical writing team, and are evolving our approach to content at JumpCloud. We are looking for an experienced **Technical Writer** to lead, scale, and optimize our product and developer documentation. In this role, you won't just write—you will act as an information architect and workflow innovator.

You will leverage cutting-edge AI documentation tools, prompt engineering, and modern automation to streamline content creation. Your goal is to keep our documentation technically accurate, end user focused, and optimized for both human readers and AI retrieval systems (RAG/chatbots).

### **Key Responsibilities :**

#### **Docs-as-Code & Version Control Management**

* **GitHub Native Workflow:** Manage documentation using standard developer tools—drafting in Markdown, managing branches, opening Pull Requests (PRs), and conducting code reviews in GitHub.
* **Continuous Publishing:** Integrate into automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Static Site Generators (e.g., Docusaurus, MkDocs, Hugo).
* Maintain strict version control across multiple product releases, API versions, and branch merges.

**Content Generation & In-App User Guidance**

* Author, edit, and maintain clear, accurate end user documentation (API references, developer guides, user how to’s, configuration guides, and release notes) for IT admins and their teams.
* **Cross-collaboration**: Partner closely with Engineering, Product Managers, and Designers to translate UX designs, and technical specs into intuitive content.
* **UX Writing**: Work with Design to provide copy and improve UX prototypes.
* **Manage Rolling Product Releases**: We have continuous releases meaning teams push new features and updates any time throughout the quarter. You should feel comfortable managing and prioritizing 15-20 feature/update releases during a quarter.

* **Conduct rigorous technical validation**: Test feature flags in the product, API endpoints, run sample code, and verify UI flows before publishing.
* **In-App Engagement**: Design, deploy, and manage in-app onboarding flows, tooltips, and release announcements using Pendo (or similar platforms like Appcues/WalkMe).

**AI Tooling & Workflow Optimization**

* **Prompt Engineering:** Design, test, and standardize custom prompts and prompt templates to accelerate process, information architecture, media, and content reformatting.
* **AI-Assisted Efficiency:** Integrate AI assistants into daily workflows to drastically reduce time spent on repetitive tasks (e.g., generating initial drafts, converting legacy docs, auditing terminology etc).
* **Human Quality Control:** Act as the final filter for AI-generated outputs, rigorously auditing content for technical accuracy, brand tone, hallucinations, and security compliance.

### **Requirements & Qualifications :**

* **Experience:** 4-7+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Engineer, or Product Content Strategy Specialist in a SaaS or tech environment.
* **GitHub & Docs-as-Code (Required):** Proven mastery of **GitHub** (PRs, code reviews, branch management), Markdown, and Static Site Generators within a **Docs-as-Code pipeline**.
* **AI & Prompting Fluency:** Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants, etc) and a working knowledge of prompt engineering techniques.
* **Technical Depth:** Ability to quickly contribute to the platform and new features quickly given highly technical, and nuanced specifications.
* **Critical Thinking:** Strong editorial judgment. We want you to be able to catch subtle hallucinations, out-of-date parameters, or security risks in AI assisted drafts.
* **In-App Notification Tools (Required):** Hands-on, demonstrated experience building and targeting in-app messaging, guides, and analytics using **Pendo** (or comparable tools like Appcues, Userpilot, WalkMe).

### **Additional Qualifications We Value :**

* Experience using Pendo to track documentation consumption and guide completion rates.
* Experience training and refining AI models on internal style guides and technical glossaries.
* Background in API design or developer-focused content strategy.
* Ability to create JSON scripts.

**Kindly share your portfolio while applying for the role. This can include documentation samples, AI prompts, demo video or video recordings of using AI to improve a process, examples of in-app notifications/announcements or onboarding flows, Git repositories etc.**

###### **#LI-MS1**

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

**Language:**

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. title: Senior Technical Writer
description:

As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

### **About the Role**

Monks is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Writer / Editor to join a regional creative team producing rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Working in close partnership with client stakeholders and a distributed global team, this role will refine complex technical material into clear, engaging content for consumer-facing audiences who are already comfortable with technology. All editorial and creative deliverables will be produced in English for global audiences.

This role is primarily focused on editing and adapting approved source content rather than writing technical narratives from scratch. The ideal candidate can improve clarity, structure and tone without diluting technical meaning, introducing inaccuracies or oversimplifying the subject matter.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.

### **In This Role, You Will**

* Edit and refine technical editorial and marketing content for clarity, accuracy, flow and audience relevance.
* Preserve essential technical meaning while making complex information accessible and engaging.
* Adapt approved source copy across web, social, video, presentation and other digital formats.
* Create copy variants based on platform requirements, audience needs, character limits and established messaging.
* Develop and refine headlines, subheads, summaries, captions, calls to action and on-screen copy.
* Apply approved copy within design layouts, working closely with designers to balance meaning, hierarchy and available space.
* Partner with subject matter experts to clarify technical details and resolve gaps or inconsistencies.
* Work with producers to track copy status, approvals, source material and open questions.
* Consolidate editorial feedback and recommend resolutions when comments are subjective, conflicting or unclear.
* Maintain established terminology, naming conventions, voice and editorial standards.
* Conduct thorough copy QA across spelling, grammar, punctuation, factual consistency, links, versioning and platform specifications.
* Document approved language, recurring feedback and editorial decisions for future use.
* Support clear, documented handoffs when work continues across regions or shifts.
* Use approved AI and editorial tools to support research, comparison, versioning and efficiency while maintaining human editorial judgment.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

### **Experience You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical editing, technical writing, technology journalism, digital publishing or editorial marketing.
* Demonstrated ability to edit complex technology content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Experience writing for technically fluent consumer, professional or business audiences.
* Strong understanding of digital editorial structure, information hierarchy and platform-specific copy requirements.
* Experience adapting a single source narrative into multiple formats and copy variants.
* Exceptional command of written English, including grammar, syntax, tone and editorial style, is required. All copy will be developed and edited in English.
* Strong proofreading, fact-checking and self-QA skills.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage rapid turnarounds and make sound editorial decisions amid ambiguity.
* Confidence collaborating with technical experts, designers, motion artists, producers and senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with collaborative design tools such as Figma is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across regions, time zones and shift-based teams.
* Ability to work an assigned nontraditional shift and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.

### **Working Model**

This is a hybrid, shift-based role supporting a global production model. Working hours will vary by assigned shift and may include early mornings, evenings, overnight coverage or other nontraditional schedules. Participation in a planned weekend and holiday rotation will also be required. Schedules will be established in advance, with some flexibility needed around urgent priorities and cross-regional handoffs.

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

### **About the Role**

Monks is seeking an experienced Senior Motion Artist / Editor to join a regional creative team producing rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Working in close partnership with client stakeholders and a distributed global team, this role will transform existing footage, design assets and approved content into polished, engaging video and motion deliverables.

The ideal candidate combines strong editing instincts with motion-design expertise. You should be equally comfortable shaping an edit, animating graphics and timing visuals to audio, while working closely with the design team to maintain a cohesive visual system.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.

### **In This Role, You Will**

* Edit existing footage and approved content into clear, engaging video deliverables.
* Create motion graphics, animated typography, transitions and supporting visual elements.
* Apply established brand guidelines, motion principles and design systems across all work.
* Use existing content thoughtfully to make technical and editorial stories more dynamic and accessible.
* Time edits and animation precisely to voiceover, music and other audio elements.
* Partner with designers to adapt static assets, layouts, charts and graphics for motion.
* Work with technical writers and producers to maintain narrative clarity and content accuracy.
* Interpret briefs and feedback independently, identifying gaps and asking focused questions when needed.
* Create efficient workflows and reusable motion components that support rapid-turn production.
* Prepare organized project files that can be easily understood and continued by distributed teams.
* Support clear, documented handoffs when work continues across regions or shifts.
* Conduct thorough self-QA across visual quality, timing, audio, spelling, brand alignment, specifications and version control.
* Incorporate feedback quickly while maintaining craft and consistency.
* Use approved AI and creative technology tools to support editing, animation and production efficiency.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

### **Experience You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in motion design, video editing or post-production within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
* Working proficiency in Figma, including navigating files, reviewing components and exporting production-ready assets.
* Strong motion-graphics, animation and editorial storytelling skills.
* Experience working with existing footage, static design assets, voiceover and music.
* Strong understanding of pacing, timing, composition, typography and audio synchronization.
* Ability to animate charts, diagrams and technical information clearly and accurately.
* Familiarity with established brand systems, templates and reusable motion toolkits.
* Strong file organization, version-control and self-QA practices.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage rapid turnarounds and maintain quality when priorities shift.
* Experience collaborating across regions, time zones and shift-based teams.
* Ability to work an assigned nontraditional shift and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required, as all briefs, feedback and creative deliverables will be in English.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.

### **Working Model**

This is a remote shift-based role supporting a global production model. Working hours will vary by assigned shift and may include early mornings, evenings, overnight coverage or other nontraditional schedules. Participation in a planned weekend and holiday rotation will also be required. Schedules will be established in advance, with some flexibility needed around urgent priorities and cross-regional handoffs.

**About Monks**

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek's first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show's inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

title: Controls Documentation Engineer
description:
**Brief Job Description:**  

Technical Writer:


Responsible for researching, writing and editing customer\-facing documentation such as user manuals, online help systems and quick installation guides. Able to work with and facilitate positive relationships with Global Business Units (GBUs), all Lines of Business (LOB), other departments and OEM customers with specific needs. With guided supervision and sometimes limited product specifications, can fully support and manage both local and remote documentation projects from start to finish.


**Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:**

**(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)**

* Researches, writes and edits various product documentation for advanced technology products in English language.
* Gathers technical information proactively. Research available engineering information. Interviews engineers and other technical personnel to ensure the clarity, completeness, accuracy and quality of the documents created.
* Assembles documentation in correct Vertiv or OEM format, keeping structure, content and organization consistent with established standards and styles.
* Develops online help, API documentation and Command Reference Guides for software applications per established standards, styles and guidelines.
* Able to manage multiple complex project schedules across multiple product lines and businesses.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

**Required/ Minimum Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 3 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSC\- any stream/BCA or equivalent degree). Additional degrees/certifications in professional writing, technical writing, digital writing/communications, journalism or English are preferred. At least 5 or more years of equivalent experience in a relevant field may be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.

**Additional / Preferred Qualifications:**

* Fluent in and able to communicate, understand and explain complex concepts in English.
* Experience with writing for localization and working with international teams.
* Experience with CSS, XML and XHTML.
* Proficiency in the following programs: Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat DC Pro, Adobe InDesign and Madcap Flare (or equivalent experience with a single\-source desktop publishing tool).
* Strong interpersonal, communication and editing skills with high attention to detail.
* Self\-motivated with the desire to be a team\-player and support team goals and mission.
* Ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced, international team environment with multiple deadlines, limited resources and constant change.
* Ability to support multiple time zones when needed.

**Physical \& Environmental Requirements: \- (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)**

* Standard physical demands of desk work

**Time Travel Needed:**

* 25%
